(5) All existing liabilities incurred by or on behalf of or for the purposes
of the University Hospital under the revoked Statute shall, on the coming into
operation of this Statute, be enforced against the University Malaya Medical
Centre.

(6) All references to the University Hospital in any instrument, deed, title,
document, bond, agreement and working arrangement made under the revoked
Statute and subsisting immediately before the coming into operation of this
Statute shall, on the coming into operation of this Statute, be construed as
references to the University Malaya Medical Centre.

(7) The instrument, deed, title, document, bond, agreement and working
arrangement referred to in subsection (6) shall, on the coming into operation
of this Statute:

(a) be deemed to have been made under this Statute; and

(b) continue to be in force and have effect.

(8) All orders, notices, forms and authorization letters issued or made under
the revoked Statute shall remain in force in so far as they are not inconsistent
with the provisions of this Statute.

Made 27 April 2000.
[KP(PUU)S 10075/05/14; PN(PU2)75-W Pt. II]

SULTAN AZLAN MUHIBBUDDIN SHAH [BNI ALMARHUM SULTAN YUSUF

Chancellor,
